## Problem

Describe the user-visible or operational problem this change solves.

## Change

Summarize the focused change and any state, API, or message-format effects.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and the result.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept credentials, chat IDs, private messages, and production state out of the diff.
- [ ] I added or updated offline tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I documented failure behavior and external API effects.
- [ ] I updated both English and Traditional Chinese documentation when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran `python -m ruff check .` and `python -m pytest`.
